policy_classes.capture: only matching selected od D pins
policy_classes.invariant: Normal RUN epoch: accepted write reserves slot; accepted wp Gray publishes one write edge later, passes two read FF stages, and read take uses previous second-stage value. After read, rp Gray passes two write FF stages and reuse can only be accepted on the following write edge.
policy_classes.ideal_earliest_capture_after_last_select: Tw + 2Tr; subtract actual source/publication clock skew, pointer route delays, capture aperture and uncertainties before any policy adoption
policy_classes.policy: Request a bounded source-to-capture transport/stability contract only after exact proof and per-corner source/publication/pointer/capture timing. Do not adopt blanket data false paths.

policy_classes.class_: Gray pointer and onebit online first synchronizer aperture
policy_classes.invariant: Each accepted Gray publication changes at most one bit during normal RUN; online DOWN/RUN cross as independent single-bit signals with DOWN priority. Reset/quiescence is a separate explicit epoch protocol.
policy_classes.policy: True first-stage synchronizer aperture requires exact scoped CDC policy and measured transport/skew/metastability-resolution qualification. First-to-second stage remains ordinary timed same-domain logic.

policy_classes.class_: read address, take, mux and output control
policy_classes.policy: All rd_bin/r_take/readmux same-domain source paths retain ordinary setup/hold checks. Memory bundle grouping cannot exempt address/control arcs. No clock-group exception.

reset_transition_scope: Whole raw epoch suppresses both domains immediately; unilateral conditioned reset may have old in-flight acceptances before peer observation, explicitly discarded in the tested quiescence window. Normal stable-entry invariant does not assert arbitrary pointer/Gray reset jumps are unit steps.
